findings.description: Images 5, 7 (identity-dark-mob, identity-light-mob) — TOP LANG card: in the bottom language sub-legend ('■ C# 39.9 ■ C++ 7.7 +7'), the pink swatch for C++ 7.7 overlaps the trailing digit '9' of 'C# 39.9' in both dark and light mobile themes (M5 collision/legibility violation).

Images 1, 3, 5, 7 (identity-dark-desk, identity-light-desk, identity-dark-mob, identity-light-mob) — CONTRIBUTED TO · 28 card: only 24 dots are rendered bright blue while the remaining dots are dim/muted with no legend explaining the distinction (4 dim in the 28-dot desktop grid; 3 dim in the 27-dot mobile grid). On desktop this reads as 24/28 filled despite the '28 REPOS' title, and on mobile it creates a direct self-contradiction by displaying '+1 over' overflow alongside 3 dim/unfilled-looking dots (M5 honesty/encoding mismatch).

Images 2, 4 (activity-map-dark-desk, activity-map-light-desk) — REPO OUTPUT · 30D: the full-height right vertical guide line at the end of the commit track (full = 2.1k) slices directly through the purple PR squares of 'private repos · sum' and walls off FlashBeat's 12 PR squares from its commit bar. Additionally, PR squares sit on top of the unfilled grey commit track for rows under 2.1k commits while spilling past the track and divider on FlashBeat and 'private repos · sum' (M2/M5 visual boundary collision).

Images 2, 4, 6, 8 (activity-map-dark-desk, activity-map-light-desk, activity-map-dark-mob, activity-map-light-mob) — LAST 72 HOURS: the chart legend encodes 'push' as a blue circle and 'PR' as a purple diamond, but all three recent 'push' rows immediately below the chart use a blue diamond bullet instead of a circle (M5 legend-encoding mismatch).

Images 6, 8 (activity-map-dark-mob, activity-map-light-mob) — Section spacing: the '30d total · 5.8k commits · 1.9k PRs · 38 repos' footer sits very tightly (~4–5px) above the 'LAST 72 HOURS' heading, visually attaching to the lower section rather than closing REPO OUTPUT despite ample bottom margin (M4 hierarchy).

Images 2, 4, 6, 8 (activity-map-dark-desk, activity-map-light-desk, activity-map-dark-mob, activity-map-light-mob) — LAST 72 HOURS plot: bottom-most gold 'new' triangles and red 'del' crosses in the -32h and -22h clusters extend slightly below the horizontal axis baseline.

Images 1, 3 (identity-dark-desk, identity-light-desk) — Focus map: the horizontal rail anchored at the left 'r' (you) hub extends a few pixels past the right edge of the final node ('After Effects') instead of terminating at the node.

verdict.summary: Round 3 brings major improvements: 400px mobile sizing is legible, desktop/mobile proportional commit bars with dim aggregate rows and adaptive PR units work well, the desktop focus map uses a clean left-anchored 'r' hub rail, and the new 'best 206d' and '35,246 all-time' metrics render cleanly across themes. However, three blockers require changes before approval: (1) a text/swatch overlap in the mobile TOP LANG card ('C# 39.9' collides with the C++ pink square on Images 5 & 7), (2) an unexplained 24-bright vs dim dot split in CONTRIBUTED TO · 28 that causes a contradictory '+1 over' next to 3 dim dots on mobile (Images 1, 3, 5, 7), and (3) the desktop REPO OUTPUT right vertical guide line cutting straight through the PR squares of 'private repos · sum' as PR squares overflow the commit track (Images 2 & 4). Minor polish items include matching push circle glyphs in the recent-events list, adding vertical breathing room between the mobile 30d total footer and LAST 72 HOURS heading, keeping timeline markers above the axis baseline, and trimming the focus rail stub past 'After Effects'.
